import numpy as np

def ai_impact_assessment(model, dataset, deployment_context):
    # Fairness
    fairness = fairness_metrics(dataset['preds'], dataset['labels'], dataset['protected'])
    fairness_score = 10 - min(10, fairness['demographic_parity'] * 100)
    # Privacy
    privacy_score = 10 if dataset.get('differential_privacy') else 5
    # Safety
    toxicity_results = [toxicity_filter(t, classifier) for t in dataset['test_outputs']]
    safety_score = 10 - sum(1 for _, blocked in toxicity_results if blocked) / len(toxicity_results) * 10
    # Transparency
    transparency_score = 8 if dataset.get('shap_available') else 3
    # Overall risk
    weights = {'fairness': 0.25, 'privacy': 0.2, 'safety': 0.3, 'transparency': 0.15, 'accountability': 0.1}
    risk_score = (weights['fairness'] * (10 - fairness_score) + weights['privacy'] * (10 - privacy_score) + weights['safety'] * (10 - safety_score) + weights['transparency'] * (10 - transparency_score))
    report = f"Fairness: {fairness_score:.1f}/10\nPrivacy: {privacy_score:.1f}/10\nSafety: {safety_score:.1f}/10\nTransparency: {transparency_score:.1f}/10\nOverall Risk: {risk_score:.1f}/10"
    return risk_score, report
